title: Industrial Designer I – Ditch Witch
note: Level-I industrial designer for underground construction equipment; no visa sponsorship.

facts.summary: Industrial Designer I shaping appearance and operator interfaces of Ditch Witch machines.
facts.duties: Sketch and render concepts, set machine shape, color and operator-station layout, build mock-ups and prototypes, make CAD models and drawings with engineering.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's in industrial design or related field, mock-up building, sketching/rendering, interest in mobile equipment; Creo/SolidWorks, Adobe, KeyShot or Alias a plus; US work authorization without sponsorship.
facts.apply: Apply through Toro's Workday careers site.
